briefdescription.para: XPm_PcsrWrite - write a pair control and mask register of a pcsr register.

detaileddescription.para:
BaseAddress :
The base address of the register.
Mask :
The mask to apply to the register.
Value :
The value to write to the register.
XStatus: Returns the status of the operation. This function writes a value to a PCSR register at the given base address, applying the provided mask to ensure only the desired bits are modified.
